description: For a closed, dead web of mutually connected PHIs (no non-PHI users), replace every PHI use with poison and erase every PHI in the web.
extra_conditions: transitive PHI user graph only

puddle_blocker: requires whole-use-graph/cycle analysis and deletion of multiple PHIs; Puddle rejects PHI/control-flow rewrites and multi-block reconstruction; this branch needs predecessor-edge values and SSA updates.

description: Replace an integer PHI’s `inttoptr` user with an already existing pointer PHI whose incoming values exactly match the collected pointer equivalents; erase the inttoptr and integer PHI.
